 AstroDevam , Anita Baranwal & Dr Achary Kalki Krishnan / TOI Astrology / Nov 10, 2026, 01:00 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print General: The Moon positioned in Scorpio in your seventh house shapes your entire day, highlighting joint projects and the wishes of others. A casual outing or a relaxing pause could be attractive, as long as all participants have consented to the details. Working together can keep the day enjoyable, though you should allow for the possibility that someone might opt out or adjust their schedule. Jupiter placed in Leo in your fourth house turns the spotlight toward home life, learning, and emotional backing. You may prioritize comfort over excitement, yet household duties and the associated costs still need to be factored into your plans. Watch One Powerful Mantra Jaap Unlock Prosperity , Wealth , Health | Prabhuji Nityanand Charandas Love and Relationship: A heartfelt invitation or a considerate present can show your interest without pressuring an instant reply. With Venus, the planet that rules you moving retrograde and weakened in Virgo within your fifth house, you’re prompted to reevaluate your romantic ideals instead of measuring a bond by one single act. When a friend or family member proposes an introduction, give yourself space to see if your core values align. Long‑term couples might find joy in revisiting a shared, uncomplicated pastime. Be sure to talk about the expense and schedule ahead of time so that a loving arrangement stays enjoyable rather than feeling like a duty. Education and Career: A retrograde Saturn positioned in Pisces within the eleventh house encourages steady, patient effort toward finishing projects and keeping solid professional connections. It’s more productive to discuss a task that’s still pending rather than chase a brand‑new prospect, giving trusted contacts a clear point of reply. Meanwhile, a retrograde Rahu in Aquarius in the tenth house paired with a retrograde Ketu in Leo in the fourth house reveals a lasting tension between outward ambition and inner satisfaction. With Jupiter also located in Leo, it’s wise to give equal weight to a functional study area or a sustainable home routine as you pursue career visibility, and to avoid over‑committing yourself beyond what you can realistically maintain. Money and Finance: Having fun doesn’t require picking the priciest choice. Determine your budget for a trip, present, or home comfort before you finalize any reservation. Even under Saturn’s extended influence, patient progress is still attainable, but don’t count anticipated earnings as money already in hand. If you’re splitting expenses, make the agreement clear. Generosity becomes more pleasant when everyone knows exactly what’s expected afterward. Health and Well-being: Incorporate brief breaks into your social activities, especially when they involve traveling or a lengthy day. Remember to stay hydrated and eat consistently, but don’t let minor fluctuations in energy cause worry. If discomfort continues, consult a healthcare professional rather than self‑diagnosing from fleeting symptoms or internet searches. Tip for the Day: Agree on the outing budget before booking, shopping or inviting anyone along.
